diagnosis: On a touchscreen the last InputEventScreenTouch is the tap on the on-screen CAST button (drax's web overlay, bottom of the screen), so vfx_cursor_override = the button's world position = behind/below the follow-camera-centred Keeper; the cast resolves toward it. Mouse users never hit this because mouse events clear the override. On the shipped web overlay every ScreenTouch is handled before Keeper._unhandled_input, so the prior T4i bookkeeping may never run and the browser-emulated mouse also remains on the CAST button.

implementation.device_rule: With no probe override, DisplayServer.is_touchscreen_available() or vfx_force_touch_device resolves directly to Keeper position + normalized facing * kit range * art_scale. Mobile bypasses prop targeting as well as pointer input.
implementation.probe_hook: A non-null vfx_cursor_override takes precedence over the device branch and retains the existing G1 resolver path.
implementation.desktop: Original mouse expression and G1 resolver arguments retained.
implementation.bookkeeping: Removed all pointer-event bookkeeping and world-touch aiming; no input handler survives.
